summary: Worker J. Smith experienced a fall, as indicated by the ARGUS-001 device, which recorded a peak acceleration of 12.4 g during a 450 ms free-fall lasting an estimated 0.99 m. The event occurred while the worker was wearing the hard hat.

sequence_of_events.description: Fall detected: 450 ms of free fall (estimated drop 0.99 m) ending in an impact of 12.4 g.
Confirmation buzz on both motors (1.5 s) to tell the wearer the event was recorded.

evidence.environment: Near-wearer conditions (indicative): CO2 612 ppm, temperature 21.4 C, relative humidity 38%

risk.severity_justification: The fall resulted in a peak acceleration of 12.4 g, which is a severe impact.
risk.likelihood_justification: The fall was recorded by the ARGUS-001 device, indicating it occurred during a free-fall, which is a high-likelihood event.

immediate.description: The worker was not wearing a harness or other fall protection equipment.
The worker was not wearing a hard hat with a built-in fall detection system.

root_five_whys: Why was the worker not wearing a harness or other fall protection equipment? Because the site supervisor did not ensure the worker was properly equipped.
Why was the worker not wearing a hard hat with a built-in fall detection system? Because the equipment operator did not provide the worker with the appropriate PPE.
Why was the site supervisor not ensuring the worker was properly equipped? Because the health and safety coordinator did not conduct a risk assessment for the task.
Why was the equipment operator not providing the worker with the appropriate PPE? Because the site supervisor did not prioritize worker safety.
Why was the health and safety coordinator not conducting a risk assessment for the task? Because the site supervisor did not prioritize worker safety.

corrective_actions.description: Ensure all workers are properly equipped with fall protection equipment.
Provide workers with hard hats equipped with fall detection systems.
Conduct a risk assessment for all tasks to identify and mitigate fall hazards.

regulatory_note: This incident may meet the threshold for a serious-incident or dangerous-occurrence notification under provincial regulations. Please verify with your provincial OHS regulator.
confidence_and_gaps: No video was available for this incident, so the physical contact with the hat and the worker's actions during the fall cannot be confirmed.
